about: Low resting room-air readings recur on two dates while stable, and the respiratory service records home oxygen only for exertion.
Results show low blood oxygen, and oxygen is supplied every month from the day after the result to the end of the record, so nothing is missing.
Resting room-air oxygen readings are low, and the respiratory service documents current long-term home oxygen for at least 15 hours daily.
The low saturation was measured during pneumonia, and resting room-air saturation was 96 percent after recovery.
